title: Corrugated packaging
summary: 30 carton and mailer sizes for a D2C home-care brand, about ₹4 crore a year.
whyCheapestIsWrong: The cheapest vendor fails the quality gate.
edges: Excel with its own item codes, some prices per 100
PDF with a 4% discount hidden in a footnote
Word doc quoting in USD, prices inside paragraphs
Angled photo of a rate card, 27 of 30 lines, mailers per box of 25
Three-line email: per kg, and "rest same as last year"
questions: What came back, and what can't I trust yet?
What if we split it, cheapest per line, but only among vendors who cleared the quality questionnaire?
What does that cost versus giving it all to one vendor?
Cap it at two vendors.
Where are prices up most against last year? Show a chart.
Which vendor has the best on-time delivery?

title: IT hardware refresh
summary: Laptops, desktops, monitors, docks, peripherals, network gear and UPS for a new Bengaluru office, about ₹4 crore.
whyCheapestIsWrong: The cheapest prices are for substitute models.
edges: Excel with several sheets and price breaks by quantity
PDF where the 3-year warranty is a separate add-on per item
Word doc in USD that offers "equivalent" models on some lines
Photo of a printed price list, 22 of 30 lines, some priced per pack of 10
Short email: "10% off our last PO rates for laptops"
questions: Cheapest per line among vendors who cleared the quality gate, counting only exact-match models.
Which lines got a substitute, and what does the exact model cost elsewhere?
What changes if everything has to arrive in 21 days?
What does a 3-year warranty add, by vendor?
If we buy 600 standard laptops instead of 400, does the winner on that line change?
Which vendor has the fewest warranty claims?

title: Road freight lanes
summary: 30 full-truckload lanes out of the Pune and Hosur plants, about ₹4 crore a year.
whyCheapestIsWrong: The cheapest carrier cannot supply enough trucks.
edges: Excel with clean per-trip rates and a trucks-a-month limit on each lane
PDF priced per tonne, with a diesel clause in a footnote
Word doc priced per km, one paragraph per region, tolls extra
Screenshot of a WhatsApp chat, 18 of 30 lanes, vehicle size missing on some
Email: "current contract rates plus 6%", and no south lanes
questions: Cheapest per lane among carriers who cleared the quality gate, but nobody gets more trucks than they said they can supply.
Which lanes have only one bidder?
What happens to that award if diesel goes up ₹5?
Where is the fastest carrier more than 10% dearer than the cheapest?
What does it cost to give everything to one carrier?
What will tolls add on Deccan Express's lanes?

title: MRO spares
summary: 30 maintenance spares for a forging plant at Chakan: bearings, belts, seals, filters, switchgear, hoses and consumables, about ₹25 lakh a year.
whyCheapestIsWrong: No vendor covers the whole list, and some of the lowest prices are for an equivalent brand.
edges: Excel price list with their own part codes and a minimum order column
PDF quotation with "equivalent" makes and lead times in the remarks
Word offer priced per pack, per carton and per metre
Photo of a handwritten counter quote, 12 of 30 lines
Short email: "list less 32%" and "as attached last month", no prices
questions: What is the smallest set of vendors that covers all 30 lines?
What do the minimum order quantities cost us in the first year?
Which lines only have an equivalent, not the brand we asked for?
What changes if everything has to arrive in 3 weeks?
